title: Exercise an ordinary mutation in the failed-startup control regression
outcome: Restore proof that a failed work-session host startup cannot dispatch queued ordinary mutations.
acceptance: The failed-startup dogfood test queues a valid ordinary mutation for a seeded project/work claim, retains one-response/exit assertions, and proves relevant durable state stays unchanged for startup refusal and busy paths.
A healthy-server positive control proves the same mutation frame normally changes the expected state, so invalid or read-only input cannot satisfy the test.
The regression uses the ordinary work-session route and does not restore removed turn or grant operations.
